verified_facts.text: Wynn Las Vegas and Encore is at 3131 Las Vegas Blvd. South in Las Vegas.
verified_facts.excerpt: 3131 Las Vegas Blvd. South

verified_facts.text: Wynn Golf Club is an 18-hole championship golf course designed by Tom Fazio.
verified_facts.excerpt: From lush greens to rushing streams, you may forget you’re in Las Vegas at our Tom Fazio-designed course. Wynn Golf Club is now open.

verified_facts.text: Encore offers an all-suite experience.
verified_facts.excerpt: Encore's all-suite experience is spacious, elegant and defined by thoughtful details

verified_facts.text: Wynn Tower Suites guests get an exclusive entrance, a daily breakfast credit and a private pool deck.
verified_facts.excerpt: An exclusive entrance, daily breakfast credit and private pool deck for Tower Suites guests are just three amenities included with your spacious accommodations.

verified_facts.text: Wynn Panoramic Corner King rooms have two walls of floor-to-ceiling windows and are on the 28th floor and above.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy spectacular views via two walls of floor-to-ceiling windows in these corner rooms located on the 28th floor and above.

verified_facts.text: Wynn's Fairway Villa comes in one- or two-bedroom configurations with a private patio or balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: In one- or two-bedroom configurations, Wynn’s Fairway Villa is ideal for entertaining and features a private patio or balcony.

verified_facts.text: The art in the rooms and suites was all commissioned for Wynn.
verified_facts.excerpt: The art, all commissioned for Wynn, is generous in size, while the bed has a really confident presentation

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites are designed in soft, subtle hues with layered lighting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wynn Las Vegas guest rooms and suites are designed in soft, subtle hues, complemented by thoughtfully layered lighting that enhances both comfort and well-being.

verified_facts.text: The Wynn pools are temperature-controlled and surrounded by gardens and cabanas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Temperature-controlled pools, surrounded by immaculate gardens and fully stocked cabanas, are perfect for an afternoon of relaxation.

verified_facts.text: Mizumi serves Japanese cuisine, sushi, robata and teppanyaki beside a 90-foot waterfall.
verified_facts.excerpt: Japanese cuisine, sushi, robata, and teppanyaki, beside a 90-foot waterfall.

verified_facts.text: AFT Cocktail Deck is set along the Lake of Dreams with views of Wynn's nightly show.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set along the Lake of Dreams, AFT Cocktail Deck serves handcrafted cocktails and light bites alongside front-row views of Wynn's iconic nightly show.

verified_facts.text: The casinos have sky-lit art and floral-filled galleries.
verified_facts.excerpt: The sky-lit art and floral-filled galleries of the casinos at Wynn and Encore Las Vegas

verified_facts.text: The Shops at Wynn and Encore offer designer boutiques, and Wynn Plaza Shops combines wellness, dining and retail.
verified_facts.excerpt: Also, don’t miss our newest retail offering, Wynn Plaza Shops, where wellness, dining, and retail experiences have been designed exclusively for Wynn Las Vegas.

verified_facts.text: Clean Market IV Drip Lounge offers IV nutrient therapy on the Spa level at Wynn.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in the rejuvenating benefits of IV nutrient therapy at Clean Market IV Drip Lounge located on the Spa level at Wynn.

verified_facts.text: The Barbershop at Wynn offers traditional hot lather shaves, haircuts and beard trims using Truefitt & Hill products.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Barbershop, located adjacent to The Salon at Wynn, relies on the finely crafted products of Truefitt & Hill

verified_facts.text: The Encore Three Bedroom Duplex has two-story windows and billiard, dining and exercise rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Two-story windows highlight the views from the 5,829-square-foot Three Bedroom Duplex, with billiard, dining and exercise rooms.

verified_facts.text: Encore Panoramic View rooms are on floors 31 through 63.
verified_facts.excerpt: Panoramic View rooms span floors 31 through 63.

verified_facts.text: Sartiano's Italian Steakhouse overlooks Wynn Golf Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: Italian steaks, handmade pastas, and celebratory dining overlooking Wynn Golf Club.

verified_facts.text: Encore Beach Club has pools surrounded by daybeds and private cabanas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beautiful pools surrounded by daybeds and private cabanas

verified_facts.text: The rooms are designed by Wynn Design & Development, led by president and chief creative officer Todd-Avery Lenahan.
verified_facts.excerpt: says Todd-Avery Lenahan, president and chief creative officer of Wynn Design & Development
